meaning: a government floor for a MARKETING SEASON (kharif seasons open in October, the Rabi Marketing Season in April), not a market price and not a forecast; join it to a price date by the season that date falls in. Rabi crops' rows (wheat, gram) are Rabi Marketing Seasons (msp_cacp relabelled at its adapter, 2026-10-03; its wheat 'crop year 2023-24' column, Rs 2,275, is RMS 2024-25)
